policy.name: The Industrial Policy of Mizoram, 2025
policy.order_no: Notification No. B.16017/05/2020-C&I dated 23-05-2025 (Mizoram Gazette Extraordinary Issue No. 344, 26-05-2025)

schemes.name: Interest subsidy on term loans (new micro and small units)
schemes.clause: Industrial Policy of Mizoram 2025, para 4.4 table, Sl. 3
schemes.notes: Official text: interest on term loans subsidised up to 5% for the first 5 years; the claim is limited to Rs 10 lakh of interest paid in a full year (modelled as a Rs 10 lakh yearly cap, the most it could be); only the shortfall if another scheme already pays interest subsidy; regular repayment required.

schemes.name: Subsidy on captive power generating set (incl. renewable)
schemes.clause: Industrial Policy of Mizoram 2025, para 4.4 table, Sl. 6
schemes.notes: Official text: 50% of the cost and installation of a captive power generating set (including renewable sources), up to Rs 5 lakh per unit, for new MSMEs within 5 years of production. Applied to solar purchases the app can detect; a DG set also qualifies.

other_benefits: Power subsidy for 5 years: 60% (micro), 25% (small), 15% (medium) of power bills (para 4.4 Sl. 4); not estimated because the app does not read power bill amounts.
Land development 25% up to Rs 10 lakh and factory building 25% up to Rs 15 lakh, inside notified industrial areas, with prior approval (Sl. 1-2).
Power line 50% up to Rs 5 lakh (Sl. 5); transport of plant & machinery 50% (Sl. 7); skilling 50% up to Rs 2 lakh (Sl. 8); trade-fair stall 30% up to Rs 1 lakh (para 12).
unverifiable: Verified against the Mizoram Gazette Extraordinary No. 344 (26-05-2025), supplied by the client. The policy states detailed schemes and guidelines will be notified separately; those were not read.
Green incentives (ETP, ZLD, pollution control) are promised in para 9.1 but rates are left to later notification.
No capital investment subsidy on plant & machinery; UNNATI 2024 (central) still applies alongside.
